$Comment: An NPC-only attack that runs MMO Skill Tree's MMO_Dodge chain, for the NativeChain entry of the Demo_Boss_Caster example roster. It does nothing unless a caster roster names it, and that example ships switched off. A mob's combat only uses an attack root tagged Attack, so this one carries the bare Attack tag with an empty sub-tag list: leaving out the Melee sub-tag that vanilla combat perception keys on means a player dodging through the MMO's own MMO_Dodge root is never read as attacking. It sits beside that player-facing root and changes nothing about it. Name it in your own roster's NativeChain to give another mob the same dodge.
